tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows a saturating response to u_now, but the bridge and flux-conservation signatures point to a potentially coupled mechanism that the five fixed-context observations cannot identify. The open-branch probe can distinguish these alternatives.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit Beverton–Holt or bilinear mass action to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot rows hold the other inputs fixed, so they cannot identify the bridge mechanism or its dependence on those inputs.
The cheaper open-branch probe is better targeted to the present mechanism ambiguity.
It is irrelevant to identifying the proposed bridge mechanism.
